div.p: Load GBB demo data: customers, inquiries E-225 onwards, quotations with cost breakup, orders with project codes, design projects with checklists and timesheets, fixture BOMs with part routes and RM sizing, manufacturing and purchase orders, a BOM revision with its Design Change Record, dispatch with invoice, quality, maintenance, complaints, feedback and HR records.
Demo users log in as girish@gbb.demo, arun@gbb.demo, sandip@gbb.demo, stores@gbb.demo, planning@gbb.demo and others, password gbb@demo.

Remove GBB demo data deletes every row the load created, including the documents Odoo generated from it, and restores the company details and numbering. Your own configuration and records are not touched.
